confirmation_policy: All Train is known development evidence; no unseen holdout claim. Historical Valid and Valid prohibited.

feature_definitions.timing: Signal t at start of session; tau=immediately previous exchange session in raw-return calendar, common to all stocks. All components and disclosure state <=tau end-of-day JST. Missing tau stock row stays missing; no stale observed-session backfill.
feature_definitions.fundamental_column: ForecastOperatingProfit only, total full-year management operating-profit forecast. CurrentFiscalYearStartDate and CurrentFiscalYearEndDate exact pair. No NextYearForecast, EPS, ordinary/net-income, nonconsolidated-field or performance-driven fallback.
feature_definitions.FUND_REV: Latest finite current full-year forecast minus previous finite forecast for same Code/fiscal start/end/accounting basis; divide by latest strictly-positive PIT TotalAssets at that disclosure. Basis inferred causally from TypeOfDocument financial statements; revisions inherit prior known basis; unknown basis cannot compare. Every financial disclosure updates state: no valid comparable pair or scale -> missing; unchanged forecasts are true zero; new fiscal period never compared to old. State remains fixed until next disclosure; no duration parameter.
feature_definitions.assets: Use most recent finite positive TotalAssets already disclosed in same inherited accounting basis. Scale locked at revision disclosure; no future restatement.
feature_definitions.SECTOR33_SHOCK: Residual=raw_return-beta*TOPIX on each historical date. Equal-weight mean of finite residuals in exact contemporaneous PIT33 membership within raw-return universe; self-inclusive, minimum1 finite member (no user-requested size threshold). Unknown9999/blank missing. Map own PIT33 at tau to daily return at tau; no17/fallback/LOO/blend/horizon.
feature_definitions.AbnormalVolume: log1p(raw Volume_tau >=0) minus median of log1p volumes on immediately preceding20 price-observation rows of that Code/relisting segment; all20 must be finite nonnegative, otherwise missing. Zero volume valid. Gap>20 absent calendar sessions resets. No window or threshold search.
feature_definitions.FLOW_REV: -WithinShock*max(AbnormalVolume,0); fixed positive reversal sign. Nonpositive surprise is a genuine formula zero, never a veto.
feature_definitions.rank: For each date/component independently, raw missing filled with median of finite same-date values; if entire component/date missing all remain tied missing. Centered ordinal ranks=(2*rank_first-(n+1))/n; deterministic Code ascending resolves all genuine/imputed ties, including all-missing dates. No bulk score-zero imputation. These arbitrary ties are not economic information; raw masks, imputed contributions and tie sensitivity limits must be reported.
feature_definitions.CAUSE_COMPOSITE: centered_rank(FUND_REV_raw)+centered_rank(SECTOR33_SHOCK_raw)+centered_rank(FLOW_REV_raw), exactly1:1:1, no availability reweighting, no final rerank/EWMA.
feature_definitions.smoothing: none for all new candidates; no baseline blend or veto

model: Three fixed label-free independent portfolios; no fitted model.
selection_rule: All adoption booleans must pass for each candidate; C is primary, A/B secondary. No trial additions or rescue; eligible means next-stage research only.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block on same concatenated eligible sessions; annual holdings remain continuous

diagnostics.negative_stock_move: raw_return at tau<0; residual-negative partition saved separately. Cartesian Fundamental down/not down, sector down/up, abnormal high/normal, Within negative/positive; zero and missing retained in separate states. high=AbnormalVolume>0, fixed definition sign, no fitted threshold.
diagnostics.outputs: Each joint state and each marginal: count, mean next Train target, per-date HAC5 RankIC, raw component RankIC, signed official Long/Short gross/net/cost contributions for all3 candidates and MOM60. All states reconcile to book; negative-move states separately reconcile to negative subset. No candidate filtering. Revision event vs held state descriptive only.

slow_control.role: descriptive only; saved unchanged prior scores
